item.title: Shipping a laptop to a refugee camp in Uganda
item.description:
📝 I shared the tracking number with Django on April 1st. I found a vendor called Pack & Send with an office a few km from my house. Ugandan citizens could complete everything online, but refugees could.

item.title: Sleep research led to a new sleep apnea drug
item.description:
📝 “Sleep apnea is the most common and most serious sleep problem,” says Horner. Sleep apnea occurs when the muscles in the upper airway repeatedly collapse during sleep, leading to frequent breathing interruptions. Currently the most commonly prescribed treatment for sleep apnea is continuous positive.
🔗 Read more: https://temertymedicine.utoronto.ca/news/how-decades-sleep-research-led-new-sleep-apnea-drug

item.title: FBI director's Based Apparel site has been spotted hosting a 'ClickFix' attack
item.description:
📝 The attack seems to work as the user visits BasedApparel. PCMag encountered the attack while navigating BasedApparel. It's interesting that it's written in Applescript though.
🔗 Read more: https://www.pcmag.com/news/kash-patels-apparel-site-is-trying-to-trick-visitors-into-installing-malware

item.title: I’m writing again
item.description:
📝 I haven’t written a column since 2022. Just like everyone else, I’ve been busy all this time on Artificial Intelligence, founding with two partners a company called 2Brains (why it wasn’t 3Brains I’ll never know) that I will explain to you shortly. Writing is part of how I think; not writing for three years has felt like holding my breath.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cringely.com/2026/05/21/im-writing-again/

item.title: A blueprint for formal verification of Apple corecrypto
item.description:
📝 The algorithm must solve new problems or improve on the security of existing algorithms. The algorithm must have strong theoretical security, and must have withstood rigorous, sustained cryptanalysis from the global research community. The code must meet exacting security criteria and must not leak information.
🔗 Read more: https://security.apple.com/blog/formal-verification-corecrypto/
